premises.text: Businesses need to verify customer identities and keep their information safe
premises.evidence_span: merchants. They need to know that Emily is who she says she is, and once they've confirmed that she is who she says she is, they need to keep her information safe.

premises.text: Sidditchi allows two parties to confirm that their information is the same without exchanging it
premises.evidence_span: Sidditchi is patented software that allows two parties to confirm that the information that they have is the same without ever exchanging the information.

premises.text: The process of verifying identity can be done without sharing sensitive information
premises.evidence_span: No information left my browser. No information left the server in the bank.

premises.text: Organizations can convert verified identity attributes into the Sidditchi format for access
premises.evidence_span: get organizations that hold lots of verified identity attributes on us to convert that information into the Sedici format.

premises.text: The verification model is transactional, charging a fee for each verification
premises.evidence_span: Every verification we do, we charge a fee for.

premises.text: Providers of information receive a percentage of the verification fee
premises.evidence_span: we give 30% of that back to the provider of the information.

premises.text: There is a need for faster and more accurate identity verification to prevent fraud
premises.evidence_span: we want to bring those two things together and make it fast and accurate.

value.text: Identity verification can be done securely and efficiently without sharing sensitive information
